theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_tpr_integral_eq_weighted
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (M : Set (Euclidean N)) (θ : Euclidean N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M μHE[n] → (∀ x ∈ M, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) μHE[n]) → (∀ B : Set (Euclidean N), MeasurableSet B → μ B = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ B, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ g : Euclidean N → ℝ, ∫ z, g z ∂μ = ∫ z in M, g z * θ z ∂μHE[n]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
